_metadata.description: Gold benchmark (roadmap 1.10) for dose/UL resolution: real DSLD labels through the production enricher must yield the hand-computed per-day exposure and upper-limit verdict.
_metadata.expectation_basis: Hand-computed from each label's per-row serving basis (DSLD quantityVariants), the directions' maximum daily servings, ODS unit conversions (vitamin D 40 IU/mcg; vitamin A 0.3 mcg RAE/IU; vitamin E 0.67 mg/IU natural, 0.45 mg/IU synthetic; folic acid 1.667 mcg DFE/mcg) and the adult 19-30 ULs in rda_optimal_uls.json, written before the enricher ran. 'basis' states the arithmetic.
_metadata.assertions: over_ul must match on the nutrient's UL-assessed row (and no row of that nutrient may be over when the verdict is false); safety_per_day, when given, must match a UL-assessed row within 0.5%. Compound-mass rows (salt weight) must never carry the verdict. When safety_unit is given, the matching row's safety_exposure unit must equal it.
